notes.title: Add English Subtitle
notes.notes:
- Add English Subtitle in the game. Now there are Thai and English.
- You can change language from menu scene by click at "Setting" button then "Languages" button and choose your language.

notes.title: Forest Kingdom
notes.notes: Forest Kingdom Adventure Game Collect Resources which you can exchange with the villagers. Upgrade weapons, equipments, and bases to collect rare items . Insert an engaging storyline and a variety of areas for adventurers to explore!
